newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sends Iraq a warning by fax.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sends Iraq a warning by fax.

text.p: The White House on Tuesday sent a blunt warning to Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein to comply with international law -- but was forced to fax it because officials refused to accept the message.
White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry said President Bill Clinton last week sent two warnings to Baghdad in hopes of convincing Saddam to remove his troops from Kurdish areas of northern Iraq.
After Clinton ordered the launch of 27 missiles at military targets in Iraq, members of the U.S. mission at the United Nations were instructed to deliver another warning to their Iraqi counterparts.
"They refused to accept it," said Mark Parris, a special assistant to the president. "So we faxed it to them."
